description:
BLACK HALO COVEN

Join us. Transcend your limits. Achieve Perfection.

The

Black Halo Coven

is a new

Midline faction

for Starsector, built around

the pursuit of one's own goals, power and perfection

, and the belief that humanity was never meant to accept its limitations.

FEATURES

• New Midline faction

• 6 new ship designs

• 4 Coven refits of vanilla ships

• 2 new fighter wings

• New faction weapons and blueprint package

• 180+ new character portraits

• New faction star systems and colonies

• Custom faction visuals and soundtrack

• Vanilla-friendly ship design and balance

• 11 custom faction bounties

• Nexerelin support

ASCENSION     •     POWER     •     PERFECTION

At any cost.

IDEOLOGY

The Church and Path misunderstood Ludd.

The Church chose stagnation.

The Path chose destruction.

We chose Ascension.

The Coven accepts that Ludd saw genuine dangers in humanity's dependence on technology.

He was simply wrong about the answer.

Humanity should not retreat from progress. It should master it.

The Coven teaches that mankind's highest purpose is the pursuit of perfection. If cybernetics, genetic modification or other augmentations allow humanity to overcome its limitations, they should be embraced.

Machines exist to serve humanity, and even artificial intelligence may be used — carefully, under supervision and always subordinate to human will.

[close]

RELATIONS WITH THE SECTOR

Luddic Church

— Hostile. The two faiths represent opposing answers to the legacy of Ludd.

Luddic Path

— Hostile. To the Path, the Coven's embrace of augmentation and advanced technology is an abomination. To the Coven, the Path destroys what humanity should learn to master.

Hegemony

— Poor relations. The Coven's limited use of AI cores remains a constant source of tension.

Persean League

— Relatively friendly. Trade and diplomacy allow both factions to coexist despite ideological differences.

Sindrian Diktat

— Relatively friendly. Pragmatic agreements and profitable trade keep relations stable.

Tri-Tachyon

— Cautiously positive. Their shared interest in advanced technology creates common ground, even if neither side entirely trusts the other.

Independent Worlds

— Generally friendly. The Coven maintains extensive trade and has little reason to interfere with independent colonies.

The Coven has far fewer followers than the Luddic Church, but careful diplomacy and trade agreements allow it to survive despite open conflict with both major Luddic factions and persistent tension with the Hegemony.

[close]

FLEET DOCTRINE

The Black Halo Coven is a

Midline faction by philosophy as much as by technology.

The Coven does not bind itself to a single school of warfare. Ballistic, missile and energy weapons are all tools, and its fleets are expected to use whatever is best suited to overcoming the enemy before them.

The goal justifies the means.

At the same time, the Coven naturally favors more technologically advanced solutions. High-performance Midline and High Tech weaponry is generally preferred, while older Low Tech weapons see less frequent use unless they offer a clear practical advantage.

This philosophy is reflected in Coven ship design. Its hulls emphasize flexibility and support a wide variety of weapon combinations rather than being built around a single technological doctrine.

There is, however, one absolute exception.

The Coven will never use Hammer torpedoes.

Hammers have become inseparably associated with the Luddic Path and everything the Coven despises about its ideology. No tactical advantage is considered sufficient to justify their use.

For heavy strike roles, Coven fleets instead favor more advanced options such as

Reaper torpedoes

and

Dragonfire missiles

.

[close]

SHIPS

The Coven relies primarily on its own warship designs, but lacks the economic and industrial strength to field a fleet composed entirely of its own hulls.

Pragmatism takes priority over purity. Captured, purchased or otherwise acquired ships from across the Sector are readily incorporated into Coven fleets whenever they can serve a useful purpose.

Its own hulls form the backbone of the fleet, but the Coven will use whatever ships are necessary to achieve its objectives.

Acolyte class Frigate

The

Acolyte

is a compact Coven combat vessel built as a reliable and highly adaptable escort.

Its Medium Hybrid and Synergy mounts give it considerable fitting flexibility, allowing the hull to be refitted around the threats it is expected to face.

Its default variant is designed to let the Acolyte punch above its weight, hunting down smaller ships on its own while still contributing respectable firepower against larger targets.

Luminarch class Destroyer

The

Luminarch

is one of the most developed Black Halo Coven hulls and currently has the largest number of variants in the faction.

Its adaptable design allows the Coven to field multiple specialized patterns built on the same core chassis.

Aris Pattern

A hunter-killer pattern built to find vulnerable prey, unleash a concentrated strike, then disengage to vent flux.

Its

Missile Autoforge

allows it to rearm between attack runs and hunt down the next target.

Vexlia Pattern

An energy assault pattern built around its integrated

Energy Bolt Coherer

.

Combined with

High Energy Focus

, it delivers intense bursts of concentrated energy fire.

Kirbo Pattern

A defensive frontline pattern intended to hold position under heavy fire.

Its

Fortress Shield

allows it to absorb punishment and provide cover while other ships deliver the killing blow.

Ascendant class Cruiser

The

Ascendant

is the Coven's standard cruiser hull, serving as the backbone of its fleets.

It can utilize a plethora of weapons, with missiles being the notable exception. Its two hangar bays help mitigate this limitation.

Relatively durable, the Ascendant can withstand a considerable amount of enemy fire when Kirbo Pattern Luminarchs are not available to fill that role.

Its Reserve Deployment system pairs well with both offensive bomber strategies and defensive fighter configurations.

COVEN REFITS

Proven Sector hulls are given a second life in Coven service. Some receive extensive combat conversions; others retain their original capabilities beneath distinctive Coven plating and insignia.

Kite (BHC) class Frigate

The

BHC Kite

turns an unassuming utility shuttle into a compact combat escort.

A

Medium Universal mount

and two

Small Synergy mounts

allow it to carry an unusually flexible arsenal for such a small hull.

Maneuvering Jets

help it reposition quickly and keep its weapons trained on its target.

Guard, Beam and Dragonfire variants offer missile support, sustained beam pressure or a compact platform for heavier guided ordnance.

Wolf (BHC) class Frigate

The

BHC Wolf

adapts the familiar High Tech attack frigate to the Coven's preference for mixed armament.

Its

Medium Synergy

,

Small Hybrid

and dedicated missile mounts support a combination of energy, ballistic and missile weapons, while retaining the Wolf's signature

Phase Skimmer

.

Assault and Halo variants give the Coven a mobile hunter capable of pursuing smaller ships or delivering torpedo strikes against larger targets.

Mule (BHC) class Destroyer

The

BHC Mule

is a hardened combat freighter built for captains who expect their cargo runs to end in a firefight.

A

Medium Universal mount

, four small missile mounts and an integrated

Missile Autoloader

give it a substantial missile presence. Its

Active Flare Launcher

helps protect the ship while it brings its weapons to bear.

Standard and Halo variants emphasize direct combat, while the Pilgrim variant adds a

Converted Hangar

carrying a wing of Coven heavy fighters.

Apogee (BHC) class Cruiser

The

BHC Apogee

brings a proven exploration cruiser into Coven service, preserving the standard Apogee's combat and logistical capabilities beneath its distinctive devotional plating.

Its

Large Energy

and

Large Missile

mounts provide the core of its firepower, supported by an

Active Flare Launcher

. Built-in

High Resolution Sensors

and

Surveying Equipment

retain its value on long expeditions.

Available in two Coven configurations:

Radiance

, built around sustained beam pressure, and

Assault

, favoring direct energy fire.

FIGHTERS

Black Halo Coven carrier doctrine supplements its warships with heavily modified derivatives of proven Sector fighter designs, rebuilt around the Coven's own combat doctrine and technology.

Pilgrim Heavy Fighter

The

Pilgrim

is a heavily modified and substantially heavier derivative of the ubiquitous Broadsword heavy fighter.

Built for aggressive close-range engagements, each Pilgrim is armed with

2× Light Dual Machine Guns

for sustained kinetic pressure and a fighter-grade

Swarmer SRM Launcher

for engaging smaller and more mobile targets.

An integrated

Decoy Flare Launcher

provides additional protection against guided missiles, helping the fighter survive repeated attack runs.

Pilgrims operate in

three-craft wings

, combining the proven durability and straightforward combat role of the Broadsword with heavier armament and the Coven's preference for more capable individual strike craft.

Missionary Torpedo Bomber

The

Missionary

is a Black Halo Coven modification of the proven

Trident

torpedo bomber, retaining its shielded strike-bomber role while replacing its conventional Atropos armament with Coven-designed ordnance.

Each Missionary carries

2× single-shot Black Halo Missile launchers

.

The

Black Halo Missile

aiDescription: Introduces the Black Halo Coven, a faction focused on ascension and perfection through technology. It adds six new ship designs, four refits of vanilla ships, two new fighter wings, and a custom blueprint package. The faction features unique ideology, relations with other sectors, and a doctrine that favors advanced weaponry while strictly forbidding Hammer torpedoes.

changelog.1.0.5:
• Added BHC Kite, Wolf, Mule and Apogee refits with custom sprites and faction variants
• Added Captain Raid Iant the Human’s bounty
• Increased Pilgrim Heavy Fighter wing cost to 14 OP
• Rebalanced all ship variants to use their full OP budgets
• Fixed weapon slot compatibility on Radiant and Seraph variants
• Updated Halo Missile AI behavior
changelog.1.0.4:
• Completely reworked the Acolyte, including a new sprite and redesigned hull layout
• Added the Pilgrim Heavy Fighter
• Added the Missionary Torpedo Bomber
• Added the Halo Missile family: Halo Missile (Single), Halo Missile Rack and Halo SRM Pod
• Added the Black Halo Coven Blueprint Package
• Added Version Checker support
• Added Black Halo Coven faction music to fleet encounters
• Increased all Luminarch base values to 45,000 credits
• Increased the Ascendant base value to 270,000 credits
• Fixed the Acolyte Vanguard variant registration
• Removed Hammer torpedoes from Black Halo Coven faction weapon access and selection
changelog.1.0.3:
• Updated ship naming
• Added additional maneuvering thrusters to the Seraph and Acolyte to better reflect their Maneuvering Jets systems
• Rebalanced Ascendant Ordnance Points
• Adjust Ascendant weapon slots and firing arcs
